summary: Ordered list of sources with title, link, and description; can be composed in the footer of a response.
whenToUse: Making the sources of a response browsable.
Presenting editorial references selected by the consumer.
whenNotToUse: Claiming that citations were verified automatically.
Showing confidential documents without server-side authorization.

props.name: sources
props.description: Unique id, title, and href; optional description.

inherits: HTML attributes of the section, className, style, and HTMLElement ref.

keyboard.action: Reaches and follows links with the consumer’s router.

accessibility: Semantic ordered list, links with descriptive text, and a named section.
customization: Text and spacing tokens; label and description accept ReactNode.
commonMistakes: Passing untrusted URLs without validating them in the consumer.
Confusing the presence of a source with the correctness of the response.
limits: Does not download, verify, or index sources; URLs, permissions, and trustworthiness are the consumer’s responsibility.
